section: Webcast: how Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install expands rooms without a traditional room build
body:
This webcast introduces Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install from a deployment angle. The page gives a short description only.

**What to know**

- Express Install is a way to extend the Microsoft Teams experience to more meeting spaces while avoiding what a traditional room build requires.
- It relies on a standardized deployment approach, so room technology can be expanded without major infrastructure changes.
- Sarika Kesavan draws on Microsoft's own deployment experience and explains how Microsoft approaches room technology around the world.
- The session covers how Microsoft equips more spaces with collaboration technology while reusing the same deployment process, not reinventing it each time.

**When to use this**: a customer asking how to roll Teams Rooms out to many spaces quickly, or wanting to hear how Microsoft itself deploys rooms.

**Not stated in this source**: deployment steps, timings, hardware, prices and licence requirements.
